subject: Inspect actual P2 EGM local review report and native child evidence
body: Read-only inspect native P2 EGM generated report and Codex traces on exact 6decc6703 worker checkout. No mutations or reruns.

argv:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,collections,re
h=pathlib.Path.home(); root=h/'.dore/egm-p2-review-6decc67039c8'
proof=root/'.dev/egm/p2-4fa21ce51444'; report=root/'docs/design/P2-VOL00-EGM-GOLDFISH-REPORT.md'
print('ROOT_EXISTS',root.exists(),'REPORT_EXISTS',report.exists(),'PROOF_EXISTS',proof.exists())
if report.exists():
 s=report.read_text(errors='replace'); print('REPORT_BYTES',len(s),'REPORT_LINES',len(s.splitlines()))
 print('HEADINGS',json.dumps([l[:125] for l in s.splitlines() if l.startswith('#')][:35],ensure_ascii=False))
 print('STAGE_PATTERN',bool(re.search(r'Stage [5-8]|階段.?[5-8]',s,re.I)))
 print('REPORT_HEAD',s[:1400].replace('\n',' | '))
 print('REPORT_TAIL',s[-800:].replace('\n',' | '))
if proof.exists():
 for name in ('codex-exitcode.txt','codex-final.md','codex-stderr.log','plugin-list.txt'):
  p=proof/name
  if p.exists():
   s=p.read_text(errors='replace');print('FILE',name,'SIZE',len(s),'TAIL',s[-950:].replace('\n',' | '))
 ev=proof/'codex-events.jsonl'
 if ev.exists():
  counts=collections.Counter(); agents=[];errors=[]; n=0
  for line in ev.open(errors='replace'):
   n+=1
   try:x=json.loads(line)
   except:continue
   counts[x.get('type','?')]+=1
   t=str(x.get('item',{}).get('type','')) if isinstance(x.get('item'),dict) else ''
   if t: counts['item:'+t]+=1
   if 'spawn_agent' in line or 'fork_turns' in line or 'fork_context' in line: agents.append(line[:360])
   if 'error' in (x.get('type') or ''):errors.append(line[:340])
  print('EVENT_LINES',n,'COUNTS',counts.most_common(14))
  print('NATIVE_DISPATCH_MATCHES',len(agents),'SAMPLES',[a[:250] for a in agents[:2]])
  print('ERROR_EVENTS',[x[:220] for x in errors[-3:]])
PY
